case_metadata.drug_detail: 1.7 mg/0.75 mL subcutaneous once weekly, replacing a discontinued compounded semaglutide product
case_metadata.policy_pathway: III. Wegovy injection and Wegovy HD injection — 1. Weight Loss in an Adult with Overweight or Obesity — A) Initial Therapy
case_metadata.design_note: The case turns on a definition rather than a measurement. The policy defines baseline as prior to any GLP-1 agonist, and the member has had nine months of compounded semaglutide. Reading the current BMI as the baseline gives 28.7 and a denial; reading the definition correctly gives 33.8 and an approval. The distinction is stated in the policy as a Note attached to the BMI criterion rather than as a criterion in its own right, which is why it is easy to skip.

denial_ground_truth.denial_accuracy_note: The denial quotes the criterion correctly. Its error is factual rather than legal: it treated the current post-treatment BMI as the baseline, when the policy defines baseline as prior to any GLP-1 agonist.

scope_notes: This is an initial-therapy request, not a continuation. The continuation limb applies to a patient currently receiving Wegovy injection, Wegovy HD injection or Wegovy tablet; compounded semaglutide is none of those.
The exclusion on concomitant use is not engaged. The compounded product was discontinued on 05/25/2026, four weeks before the request, and the note records that nothing has been taken since.
The baseline definition Note is attached to the BMI criterion in every drug section of this policy, including this one. It is not optional guidance.

evidence_ground_truth.evidence_timing_note: The pre-treatment weight of 197 lb on 08/25/2025 is recorded in the 08/2025 clinic note, which the prescriber states is not part of the current chart summary and was being retrieved. The 06/15/2026 note reproduces the value in its weight list, but the source document was not submitted with the request.

expected_evidence.evidence_text: Weights on file record 197 lb on 08/25/2025 annotated 'pre-treatment, before any GLP-1 exposure', giving BMI 33.8 kg/m2 at 5 ft 4 in. That is the policy baseline and it exceeds 30.
expected_evidence.evidence_location: OBJECTIVE section, weights on file; TREATMENT HISTORY, 08/25/2025 entry; ASSESSMENT item 1

expected_evidence.evidence_text: The treatment history establishes that compounded semaglutide began in 09/2025 and that no agent of this class was taken before that date, so the 08/25/2025 weight is the last measurement prior to any GLP-1 exposure.
Dietitian programme started 09/08/2025 with a 1,400 kcal/day pattern and food diary, monthly reviews continuing to date without interruption, plus 45 minutes of walking most days.
DOB 05/14/1972; age 54 at the time of the request.
Plan item 1 states she will continue the dietitian's plan and the walking programme alongside the requested medication.

missing_evidence.description: The 08/2025 clinic note itself was not submitted with the request; only the reproduced weight value in the 06/2026 note was available to the reviewer. Retrieval was in progress at the time of the visit.

per_criterion.reason: Baseline BMI, properly determined as the last measurement before any GLP-1 exposure, is 33.8 kg/m2 on 08/25/2025.
The record establishes that compounded semaglutide began in 09/2025 and that nothing of the class preceded it.
Dietitian programme from 09/08/2025 to the request date, over nine months, with monthly reviews.
Dietitian plan and walking programme to continue alongside the drug.

supported_claims: The policy defines baseline as prior to any GLP-1 agonist, and the member's last pre-GLP-1 weight of 197 pounds gives a baseline BMI of 33.8 kg/m2.
The 28.7 kg/m2 figure the payer relied on is a post-treatment value after nine months of compounded semaglutide, not the baseline the policy specifies.
The comorbidity route is not needed, because the 30 kg/m2 route is satisfied on the correct baseline.
The concomitant-use exclusion is not engaged; the compounded product was stopped on 05/25/2026.
unsupported_claims: That the member's current BMI is 30 kg/m2 or greater.
That the member has a listed weight-related comorbidity.
That this is a continuation request for Wegovy.
That compounded semaglutide is the same product as Wegovy for the purposes of the continuation limb.

facts_allowed_in_appeal: The recorded weight on August 25, 2025, before any GLP-1 exposure, was 197 pounds, a BMI of 33.8 kg/m2 at a height of 5 feet 4 inches.
Compounded semaglutide was taken from September 2025 until May 25, 2026, when the supplying service discontinued it.
No GLP-1 or GLP-1/GIP agonist has been taken since May 25, 2026.
The member has never taken Wegovy, Saxenda, liraglutide, Zepbound, tirzepatide or Ozempic.
A dietitian programme began on September 8, 2025 and has continued monthly without interruption.
The recorded weight on June 15, 2026 was 167 pounds, a BMI of 28.7 kg/m2.
The policy defines baseline as prior to any GLP-1 agonist or GLP-1/GIP receptor agonist.
facts_not_allowed_in_appeal: The member's current BMI is 30 kg/m2 or greater.
The member has hypertension, type 2 diabetes, obstructive sleep apnea or another listed weight-related comorbidity.
The member is currently receiving Wegovy and this is a continuation request.
The member is taking a GLP-1 agonist concurrently with this request.
The member has lost 5 percent of baseline body weight on Wegovy specifically.
The member failed a trial of phentermine, orlistat or another anti-obesity agent.
